summary: "Assassins are solitary creatures. Omegas are not. I am not an assassin by trade anymore." A pause, as Coupé collects herself, the vulnerability still new and against everything she had ever worked for. "I want this job. I want the Z-Team. And that means I have to learn how to not be alone anymore. Even if we are not always agreeable, you are the least frightening person to ask. You are…good." The word hangs heavy, something unspeakable from the depths of Coupé's heart placed there. "And even if you cannot teach such a thing to me, I would ask that you at least allow me to experience what it feels like. To have a pack-mate that is good to you.""Punch-Up, sir, he—""So far it has seemed that Knuckles is the exception, not the norm. I believe you could prove that to be false.""Thank you," Waterboy says, catching them both off guard. "For trusting me.""I am…trusting you." Coupé says the words carefully, grip tight on the knife still within her hand. "Do not make me regret it."
